desks.Dividends: The only confirmed ex-date in the next four weeks is Nvidia, Dec 2, $0.25 per quarter at the unchanged rate, payable Dec 23 — a routine payment at a sub-1% yield with no capture angle. SPY's Dec 18 distribution is on the issuer's published schedule but still undeclared; the amount lands around Dec 14-15 and is the only material dividend event left in 2026 for the watchlist. Microsoft went ex Nov 19 at the raised $0.98, its 24th consecutive annual increase, first payment Dec 10. Apple last went ex Nov 12 at $0.27; Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: No watchlist name reports earnings in the next two weeks (Nov 22-Dec 6); the next prints cluster in late January 2027 (Microsoft and Tesla ~Jan 27, Apple ~Jan 28). Nvidia reported Tue Nov 17 after close — revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), Data Center $107.6B, EPS $2.70 GAAP / $2.68 non-GAAP, Q4 guide $130B with no China Data Center revenue assumed and a 71-72% gross-margin guide below Q3's 74.8%. The stock faded 2.89% on the print and is down 19.3% from the Nov 17 close in three sessions. No options-implied expected move is reportable for the window.
desks.Futures: Brent $92.57 (-3.41% on the week) and WTI $83.98 (-5.17% on the week) — a third straight weekly loss, both down about 20% in November — while three Hormuz tanker strikes hit Fri-Sat and shipments through the strait still run at roughly pre-war levels. The IEA flipped its Q4 balance to a 1.7M b/d surplus; OPEC puts 2027 demand ~4M b/d above the IEA. USDA Cattle on Feed: October placements -7.3% y/y, the lowest October since the series began in 1996. Gold settled $3,515.40 (-4.62%) and silver $41.07 (-7.41%) on Friday, a 14-month low for gold. OPEC+ meets Sun Nov 29; next EIA weekly Wed Nov 25.
desks.Parity: No parity violation was found on the watchlist. The freshest independent box-spread measurement (Nov 12 data) printed implied financing of 3.86% at the short end to 5.16% at 435 days — close to Treasury yields, not a dislocation — corroborated by Cboe's own box-spread data. S&P's style-index overhaul takes effect at the open Mon Dec 21, with pro-forma files first appearing Fri Dec 4; Bloomberg Intelligence estimates at least $375B in passive funds track the affected indices. No new parity analysis surfaced in the last week.
desks.Premium: Front-month IV is elevated across the board after Friday's selloff — Nov 23 at-the-money IV runs from SPY 33.9% to Nvidia 107.4% at 2 DTE (live 1-DTE marks higher still, Nvidia 131.6%) — but no clean rich/cheap premium verdict is available. Every 20-day realized window is WINDOW-CONTINGENT: the Nov 5 crash day drives more than 30% of realized variance for all six names, and Nov 20 is now a second large down day inside the window. IV rank is UNVERIFIED for all six names. No watchlist earnings within the IV window; the front of the curve slopes up with no event hump.
desks.Quant lab: A quiet Sunday sweep — two new candidates ledgered (#326-327), run max 39, nothing TEST- or INTEGRATE-ready. #326 is a fractional Black-Scholes spectral method (score 39, ARCHIVE: European options only, no market-data validation, no code); #327 is a hybrid Asian-option pricing method under Heston (score 39, ARCHIVE: Asian exotics not on the watchlist, no code). No new arXiv q-fin submissions Nov 20-22 at sweep time; the Nov 20-22 window announces Mon Nov 23. Re-checks showed no version movement on any tracked item.
